# horroR: Horror Movie Color Palettes and Themes for R

Create atmospheric, creepy data visualizations with color palettes inspired by horror movies, custom ggplot2 themes, and special effects.

## Features

- **30+ Horror Movie Palettes**: Suspiria, The Shining, Get Out, Hereditary, and more
- **10 Mood-Based Palettes**: blood, ghostly, demonic, neonslasher, etc.
- **9 ggplot2 Themes**: theme_horror, theme_slasher, theme_supernatural, and more
- **Special Effects**: Blood drips, fog, scratches, glitch effects, and more
- **Easy-to-use Scale Functions**: scale_fill_horror(), scale_color_horror()

## Installation

```r
install.packages("horroR")
```

__Or the development version__

```r
devtools::install_github("jacobjameson/horroR")
```

## Quick Start

```{r, quick-start}
library("horroR")
library("ggplot2")

# See all available palettes
list_palettes()
```

## Palettes

### Horror Movie Palettes

```{r, show-movies, fig.height=8}
# View movie palettes
show_palettes(c("Suspiria", "TheShining", "GetOut", "Hereditary",
                "Midsommar", "TheNeonDemon", "Halloween", "Scream"))
```

### Mood-Based Palettes

```{r, show-moods, fig.height=6}
# View mood palettes
show_palettes(c("blood", "ghostly", "demonic", "neonslasher",
                "forestwitch", "vintage"))
```

## Themes

horroR includes 9 creepy ggplot2 themes:

```{r, list-themes}
list_themes()
```

### Theme Examples

```{r, theme-horror, fig.height=4}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "The Horror Theme", subtitle = "Dark and bloody") +
  scale_color_horror("blood") +
  theme_horror()
```

```{r, theme-slasher, fig.height=4}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), fill = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "The Slasher Theme", subtitle = "80s slasher vibes") +
  scale_fill_horror("Carrie") +
  theme_slasher()
```

```{r, theme-supernatural, fig.height=4}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(gear))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Supernatural Theme", subtitle = "Ethereal and ghostly") +
  scale_color_horror("ghostly") +
  theme_supernatural()
```

```{r, theme-neon, fig.height=4}
ggplot(diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds), 1000), ], aes(x = carat, y = price, color = cut)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Neon Demon Theme", subtitle = "Neon-noir horror") +
  scale_color_horror("TheNeonDemon") +
  theme_neon()
```

```{r, theme-occult, fig.height=4}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), fill = factor(vs))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Occult Theme", subtitle = "Dark rituals and gold") +
  scale_fill_horror("occult") +
  theme_occult()
```

```{r, theme-witch, fig.height=4}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#4a5a4a") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#6a8a5a", fill = "#3a4a3a") +
  labs(title = "Forest Witch Theme", subtitle = "Folk horror in the woods") +
  theme_witch()
```

## Scale Functions

Easy integration with ggplot2:

```{r, scales-discrete, fig.height=4}
# Discrete scales
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), fill = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_horror("Suspiria") +
  theme_horror()
```

```{r, scales-continuous, fig.height=4}
# Continuous scales
ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_horror_c("blood") +
  theme_horror() +
  labs(title = "Continuous Horror Scale")
```

## Special Effects

Add creepy effects to your plots:

```{r, effects-example, fig.height=5}
# Blood drips and fog
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(color = "#8b0000", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Something is watching...") +
  theme_horror()

# Note: Effects work best when viewed in a graphics device
p
```

## Utility Functions

```{r, utilities}
# Get a specific color from a palette
horror_color("blood", 4)

# Make any color creepier
creepify_color("#00ff00")  # Creepy green
creepify_color("pink", darkness = 0.5)
```

## Full Gallery

### Continuous Palette Example

```{r, volcano, fig.height = 5}
pal <- horroR_palette("Suspiria", 21, type = "continuous")
image(volcano, col = pal)
```

### Diamond Analysis with Horror Themes

```{r, diamonds-horror, fig.height = 4}
ggplot(
  data = subset(diamonds, cut != 'Fair'),
  aes(x = price, group = cut, fill = cut)
) +
  geom_density(adjust = 1.5, position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_horror("TheShining") +
  theme_vintage() +
  labs(title = "Diamond Prices by Cut", subtitle = "A vintage horror perspective")
```

### Heatmap with Blood Palette

```{r, heatmap-blood, fig.height = 5}
ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_horror_c("demonic") +
  theme_occult() +
  labs(title = "Old Faithful Eruptions", subtitle = "The ritual continues...")
```
